```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.{w, v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.HasSubobjectClassifier (CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) := by
  let I := CategoryTheory.essentiallySmallIndex C
  let S := CategoryTheory.SubobjectClassifier.ofEssentiallySmall C I
  constructor
  intro F
  use S.obj F
  intro f
  use CategoryTheory.id (S.obj F)
  intro g
  use CategoryTheory.id (S.obj F)
  intro h
  exact h
```
